name: ocr-worker-bakeoff
description: Engine bakeoff harness for ADR-11A.1. Outside the production dependency graph: stands up the types, accuracy metric, and fixture-manifest schema that the per-engine harness commits (Tesseract / PaddleOCR / RapidOCR) will consume.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(({mkdirSync,copyFileSync,readdirSync,statSync})=>{const src='src/harnesses';const dst='dist/harnesses';mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of readdirSync(src)){if(f.endsWith('.mjs')&&statSync(src+'/'+f).isFile()){copyFileSync(src+'/'+f,dst+'/'+f);}}})"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/accuracy.test.mjs tests/manifest.test.mjs tests/tesseract.test.mjs tests/bin-cli.test.mjs tests/paddleocr-onnx.test.mjs
